test_GTestEnvVarTest_testEnvVarAffectsFl: test that environment variables correctly affect the corresponding GTest flags like break_on_failure and color
test_GTestEnvVarTest_testXmlOutputFile: test that the XML_OUTPUT_FILE environment variable affects the GTest output flag for XML reports
test_GTestEnvVarTest_testXmlOutputFileOv: test that GTEST_OUTPUT environment variable overrides XML_OUTPUT_FILE when both are set for XML output
run_SetEnvVar: run SetEnvVar to set or unset an environment variable in the test environment dictionary
run_GetFlag: run GetFlag to execute the gtest_env_var_test_ executable and return its output for a given flag
